title: support local filesystem for uploading images
body:
Using an external service is not always possible because of availability or privacy issues, and won't work for offline use.
It would be great to be able to upload images or files to the local filesystem, and embed them
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
Not yet, we're focusing on user space for now.
I will list this issue to milestone.
